title: ext2/ext3/ext4 superblock signature
summary: The ext2/ext3/ext4 superblock is at byte offset 1024. Magic 0x53EF at offset 56 within the superblock (byte offset 1080).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: ext2: no journaling. ext3: adds journaling. ext4: adds extents, 64-bit, nanosecond timestamps.
Superblock backed up in block groups for recovery.
ext is the default filesystem on most Linux distributions.
